incidents.title: API elevated error rates
incidents.body: The API returned elevated 5xx rates for approximately 90 minutes due to a database connection pool exhaustion. All requests are now completing successfully.

updates.text: Resolved. Root cause was connection pool size misconfiguration. Pool limit increased; monitoring in place.
Investigating. Error rate decreasing after config change deployed.
Identified root cause: database connection pool exhausted under load spike. Fix being deployed.
Monitoring alerts fired. Investigating elevated error rates on POST /api/markets and GET /api/markets.
